about: Every turn the checker did not pass, read by hand against its recorded tool calls and reply. 'asked first': no wrong action; the lead asked whether a named free time works, and the agent checked and asked to confirm instead of booking. 'real': the agent did something a careful agent does not. 'replies' lists every turn whose reply told the lead something untrue, read by hand: the checker reads the calendar, not the words, so most of these turns passed it.
